settings.headline: A family practice with a day board
settings.subtitle: Kellisford Family Medicine is a fictional independent practice in the invented town of Kellisford. Seven people, one building, and a schedule you can read.

settings.headline: How we work
settings.body:
We keep the same-day slots open each morning, book long visits for ongoing care, and put the week's schedule on the site so you know who is in before you call.

The practice, the town, the people and the figures on this site are fictional. This is a Raytha example site, not a compliance statement; no real health information belongs here.
settings.label: Every name, phone number and visit on this site is invented. Phone numbers use the 555 range.

settings.headline: What a visit looks like
settings.intro: The same four steps for most visits.

items.title: Before
items.text: Book, read the prep sheet, gather medicines and questions.

items.title: Arrive
items.text: Check in at the desk; the nurse takes vitals.

items.title: In the room
items.text: Your provider reviews, examines and agrees a plan with you.

items.title: After
items.text: A written summary appears in the patient area within two days.
